Hymn 92: For the Beauty of the Earth
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: A-flat Major
Composer: Conrad Kocher
Lyricist/Text Author: Folliott S. Pierpoint
Category: Praise to the Lord

This is hymn number 92 titled "For the Beauty of the Earth" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in A-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Conrad Kocher and the lyrics were written by Folliott S. Pierpoint.
This hymn is categorized under: Praise to the Lord.
